newsitem.title: INDIA: Two bombs injure 18 people in northern India.
newsitem.headline: Two bombs injure 18 people in northern India.

text.p: Two bombs exploded in a northern Indian town on Wednesday, injuring 18 people, one of them seriously, police said.

One bomb went off in a vegetable market in Rohtak, 100 km (60 miles) northwest of Delhi in the state of Haryana, at 5.30 p.m. (1200 GMT). It was followed by another close by 45 minutes later, a police official said.
"They were small bombs," the official told Reuters by telephone from Rohtak, adding that the situation was under control.
Police stepped up security this week against possible separatist attacks ahead of Republic Day, which is celebrated on January 26 to mark the day India's constitution came into force in 1950.
